Triage Findings:

• The reported issue of the app crashing on startup suggests that there might have been a faulty deployment or configuration change. Additional logs and error details would be useful for further diagnosis. 

• Please note that sensitive secrets (such as DEPLOY_TOKEN) are managed securely and are not read or disclosed during the triage/review process. 

• I recommend verifying that the deployment configuration, including secret management and any environment-specific settings, is properly set up and that any recent changes are compatible with your app's initialization routines.

Overall, further investigation (e.g., reviewing detailed logs and deployment configurations) is required to pinpoint the exact cause of the crash.
